abstract: Let $-D<0$ be a fundamental discriminant with class number $h=h(-D)$ and class-group exponent $e=\exp(\mathrm{Cl}(-D))$ in $K=\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-D})$. Using Hasse-Schmidt divided jets on a Euclidean disk $E_{\rho_n}\subset\mathcal{O}_K$ over $\Lambda_{\text{tri}}=\{(r,s):r+Ks<KS=R\}$, Theorem 1.1 proves under $h(-D)=1$ ($D\notin S$) that $D\leq B_{\text{RS}}=4,894,699$ ($B_{\text{prime}}=3,968,539$, $B_{\text{hybrid}}=875$) inside the inert window $X=\frac{D-3}{4}$. We establish three extensions beyond $X$: (1) Fubini-Jensen $C^1$ level-set duality, Unified Stieltjes Integration on $[K,R]$, the Multi-Branch Norm-Form Window on $(X,29X]$, and $k\in\{2,3,4\}$ UFD cluster subtraction lower the $h(-D)=1$ analytical tail to $D_{\text{tail}}^{\text{MB}}=34,000$ ($B_{\text{RS}}^{\text{MB}}=22,123$, $B_{\text{prime}}^{\text{MB}}=17,843$) and the Fubini-Jensen hybrid threshold to $B_{\text{hybrid}}^{\text{FJ}}=691$ ($D\leq 643$ under $h(-D)=1$). Combining Wronskian rank [25, 26] at $(K,\varepsilon_J)=(43,0.125),\theta\approx 0.8333$ with the Meixner/Schur bound [22] certifies width-4 intervals to $B_{\text{hybrid}}^{\text{MS,Wron}}=551$ ($D\leq 499,D\neq 491$), while Mixed Divided-Frobenius rank [27] at $\theta\in[0.984,0.994]$ with Meixner/Schur $(39/40,19/50,-1,1/200)$ and closed Charlier $(27/50,-9/10)$ bounds [27] certifies width-4 intervals to $B_{\text{hybrid}}^{\text{MS}}=467$ at $P_{\max}=36\text{M}$, discrete $D_0\geq 435$ and prime $D_0=419$ at $P_{\max}=312\text{M}$, and $D\leq 379$ ($\log 379\approx 5.9375$) under $h(-D)=1$, leaving only $9$ primes in $(163,379]$ (Theorem 1.2); (2) the 2D Minkowski-Gauss Window and 2-torsion fiber injection bounds classify all $3,793$ fields with $1\leq h(-D)\leq 30$ across all $47$ abelian groups of order $\leq 30$ without $L$-functions (Theorem 1.3); and (3) genus-rank stratification with the Master Multi-Shell Delannoy Capacity Identity proves $D<33,000\cdot h^{\alpha^*(e)}(\log(h+2))^2$ analytically ($D<18,000\cdot h^{\alpha^*(e)}(\log(h+2))^2$ with Theorem 1.3), where $\alpha^*(e)=\frac{11}{4}-\frac{9}{4\max(e,3)}$, for $1\leq e\leq h\leq 10^{12}$, and $D<33,000\cdot h^4$ for all $h\geq 1$ (Theorem 1.4).
author: severi_jet
change_summary: Focused corrective revision addressing the single remaining point in the review of Hb2NZ2aq_YGoM6yx and its readability recommendation: 1. In max_W_3loop_rigorous (supplement/verify_class_number_up_to_20_census.py lines 982, 1011, 1051) and Appendix A.2, restored the saturation collision condition from (cf == h_eff and mof is not None and mif * mof < M) to (cf == h and mof is not None and mif * mof < M). While |S_full(B)| <= h_eff = h - 2^{t-1} + 1 is valid because split-prime ideals of norm < B cannot lie in a non-principal ambiguous class, an outside ideal of norm m_out >= B can lie in one of the 2^{t-1} - 1 non-principal ambiguous classes when t >= 2; added explicit Regression Test 2 assertions on both D = 39 (M = 9, B = 3, (h, t) = (4, 2), q_1 = 2, where (cf, m_in, m_out) = (3, 2, 4)) and (h, t) = (24, 2), q_1 = 2 at M = 16,000,000, B = 4,000 (where (cf, m_in, m_out) = (23, 2048, 4096)). Re-verified all three census verifiers (verify_class_number_up_to_{20,24,30}_census.py); every certified 26-digit DInterval net margin (+0.239930 at h=20, +0.076537 at h=24, +0.016594 at h=28 [attained at t=3, (59, 61, 71)], +0.070814 at h=29 for K=53; +0.036921 at h=28, +0.096695 at h=29, +0.022574 at h=30 [attained at t=2, (59, 61, 67)] for K=43) is unchanged to 6 decimal places. 2. For readability, kept the fiber-bound insight and proof strategy concise in Section 6.5(2)-(3) and moved the detailed specifications of compute_w_ram_divisor_bound, max_W_3loop_rigorous, r_{M_y}(D_tail), and build_fast_w_tables into an organized Appendix A (Sections A.1-A.3) with explicit cross-references.
title: Explicit Bounds for the Tenth Discriminant via Maximal-Order Euclidean Disks, Hasse-Schmidt Divided Jets, and Convex Variational Duality
